profile:
Alex Taylor - Fictional Demo Candidate
Auckland, New Zealand. This CV is synthetic and does not describe a real person.

Software engineering project experience
Built a TypeScript and React application with Next.js route handlers, REST APIs, PostgreSQL and Supabase Auth. Implemented user-owned records and row-level security. Deployed the application to Vercel with GitHub.

AI integration project
Integrated an LLM API using the Vercel AI SDK. Used Zod to validate structured JSON, retrieved relevant CV excerpts, and displayed evidence and requirement gaps. Added error handling and request limits. This was a personal prototype, not a production system used by paying customers.

Quality and collaboration
Wrote integration tests for API authorization and invalid inputs. Used GitHub issues and pull requests to collaborate with a small university team. Documented API setup and deployment steps.

Education
Bachelor of Computer Science, fictional Harbour Institute of Technology, 2025.

Skills
TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, REST APIs, SQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Git, Zod and basic Python.

Development areas
No demonstrated experience operating Kubernetes, managing enterprise security compliance, or deploying vector search at production scale. Work eligibility and professional certifications are not verified in this synthetic CV.

jobs.jobDescription: Fictional demonstration vacancy. Orbit Works is looking for an AI Integration Engineer in Auckland to integrate LLM APIs into customer workflows. Requirements: TypeScript, REST APIs, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, authentication, structured JSON output, automated tests, and clear technical documentation. Candidates should explain evidence retrieval, model limitations, request limits and failure handling. Production vector search and Kubernetes experience are preferred. Work eligibility must be confirmed separately.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Build accessible React interfaces and TypeScript REST APIs with a small Auckland team. Work with PostgreSQL, GitHub pull requests and automated tests. Familiarity with Next.js and Supabase is helpful. Share examples of projects you have shipped and explain how you handle authentication and user-owned data.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Develop SQL transformations and Python data pipelines. Validate data quality, document schemas and work with analytics stakeholders. PostgreSQL and Git experience are required. Experience with orchestration, cloud warehouses and data lineage is desirable.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Build responsive React and TypeScript interfaces with accessible forms and reliable loading and error states. Submit a small coding exercise and discuss component design, testing and browser performance. Experience with mobile web layouts is desirable.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Design Node.js REST services backed by PostgreSQL. Implement authentication, request validation and observability. Demonstrate a clear approach to authorization and secure file storage. Docker and cloud platform experience are desirable.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Create automated API and browser tests for a web product. Test user journeys, isolate regression failures and help engineers reproduce issues. JavaScript, Git and clear bug reports are required. Playwright experience is preferred.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Help staff troubleshoot account access and common application issues. Record support tickets, communicate clearly and escalate incidents. Customer service experience, technical curiosity and an organized approach are required.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Operate cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Kubernetes. Investigate reliability incidents, review monitoring and improve continuous delivery. This role requires commercial production operations experience and on-call participation.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Develop mobile applications and integrate secure REST APIs. Work with a designer on accessible navigation and layouts. Experience publishing iOS or Android applications and maintaining crash reports is preferred.

Fictional demonstration vacancy. Translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria. Model current workflows, compare implementation options and validate outcomes with users. Strong communication and a working understanding of software delivery are required.
